findings.claim: The change weakens the depth-limit denial-of-service protection for untrusted input: MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData.MaximumObjectGraphDepth rises from 500 to 5000, allowing ten times deeper object graphs and increasing stack/CPU exhaustion risk during deserialization. This security weakening is unrelated to the generator/analyzer crash fix.

receipt_plan.detail: Deserialize a payload nested 501 levels deep using MessagePackSerializerOptions.Standard.WithSecurity(MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData). The test should require rejection for exceeding MaximumObjectGraphDepth; it passes with the base value of 500 and fails with the changed value of 5000.
